tasks.baseline_rationale: Rust checked i64 arithmetic and explicit multi-module composition are the strongest directly comparable available baseline; chosen before any model traces.

exclusions.python: Unbounded integer semantics require a separately reviewed i64 shim.
exclusions.typescript: Number semantics differ and no reviewed fixed-width starter exists.
exclusions.ocaml: No independently reviewed fixed-width starter exists.

allowed_docs: CGx2 language and package docs for CGx2
Rust standard library docs for Rust

feature_scope.memory: No managed/owned regions; checked i64 arithmetic only.
feature_scope.syntax: Frozen Wave 12 scalar functions and acyclic local packages.

expected_outcomes.starter: Builds, runs, and returns an incorrect value for the default case.
expected_outcomes.reference: Passes private value cases; overflow exits nonzero with an overflow error.

equivalence.output_rule: same integer result or overflow class
equivalence.known_limit: Rust panic stderr and CGx2 diagnostic text differ; acceptance compares error class, not byte-identical diagnostics.

acceptance_criteria: The four-argument quote computes units times unit price, adds shipping, and subtracts credit exactly once.
All representable test inputs produce the specified signed i64 value in both starters.
